entries.title: II Samuel 23:1
segments: And these [are] the last words of David. David the son of Jesse said, and the man who was raised up on high, the anointed of the God of Jacob, and the sweet psalmist of Israel, said:

entries.title: II Samuel 23:2
segments: The Spirit of the LORD spoke by me, and His word [was] in my tongue.

entries.title: II Samuel 23:3
segments: The God of Israel said, The Rock of Israel spoke to me: he who rules over men justly, ruling [in] the fear of God,

entries.title: II Samuel 23:4
segments: is as the light of the morning, as the sun rises, a morning without clouds. The tender grass [springs] out of the earth through shining after rain.

entries.title: II Samuel 23:5
segments: Although my house [is] not so with God, yet He has made with me an everlasting covenant, ordered in all things, and sure. For all my salvation, and all my desire, will He not make it grow?

entries.title: II Samuel 23:6
segments: But the wicked, all of them, [shall be] like a thorn thrust away, because they cannot be taken by the hand.

entries.title: II Samuel 23:7
segments: But the man who shall touch them must be armed with iron and the staff of a spear. And they shall be utterly burned in [their] place.

entries.title: II Samuel 23:8
segments: These [are] the names of the mighty men whom David had: Josheb-basshebeth the Tachmonite, chief of the three; he [was called] Adino the Eznite, because of the eight hundred [he] killed at one time.

entries.title: II Samuel 23:9
segments: And after him [was] Eleazar the son of Dodo the Ahohite, one of the three mighty men with David when they defied the Philistines who were gathered there to battle; and the men of Israel had gone up;

entries.title: II Samuel 23:10
segments: [he] arose and struck the Philistines until his hand was weary, and until his hand clung to the sword. And the LORD worked a great victory that day. And the people returned after him only to spoil.

entries.title: II Samuel 23:11
segments: And next [was] Shammah the son of Agee the Hararite. And the Philistines were gathered together into a troop, where there was a piece of ground full of lentils. And the people fled from the Philistines.

entries.title: II Samuel 23:12
segments: But he stood in the middle of the ground and delivered it, and killed the Philistines. And the LORD worked a great victory.

entries.title: II Samuel 23:13
segments: And three of the thirty chief men went down and came to David in the harvest time into the cave of Adullam. And the troop of the Philistines pitched in the Valley of the Giants.

entries.title: II Samuel 23:14
segments: And David [was] then in a stronghold, and the fort of the Philistines [was] then in Bethlehem.

entries.title: II Samuel 23:15
segments: And David longed and said, Oh that someone would give me a drink from the water of the well of Bethlehem by the gate!

entries.title: II Samuel 23:16
segments: And the three mighty men broke through the army of the Philistines, and drew water out of the well of Bethlehem by the gate, and took [it], and brought [it] to David. But he would not drink of it, but poured it out to the LORD.

entries.title: II Samuel 23:17
segments: And he said, Be it far from me, O LORD, that I should do this. [Is it not] the blood of the men who went [in danger of] their lives? And he would not drink it. These three mighty men did these [things].

entries.title: II Samuel 23:18
segments: And Abishai the brother of Joab, the son of Zeruiah, [was] chief among three. And he lifted up his spear against three hundred [and] killed [them], and had the name among three.

entries.title: II Samuel 23:19
segments: Surely he was honored more than the three. And he was their commander. However he did not attain to the [first] three.

entries.title: II Samuel 23:20
segments: And Benaiah the son of Jehoiada from Kabzeel, a son of a mighty man, great [in] deeds. He killed two lion-like men of Moab. He went down also and killed a lion in the middle of a pit in time of snow.

entries.title: II Samuel 23:21
segments: And he killed an Egyptian, a man of form. And the Egyptian had a spear in his hand, but he went down to him with a staff and plucked the spear out of the Egyptian's hand, and killed him with his own spear.

entries.title: II Samuel 23:22
segments: These [things] did Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and had the name among three mighty ones.

entries.title: II Samuel 23:23
segments: He was more honorable than the thirty, but he did not attain to the [first] three. And David set him over his guard.

entries.title: II Samuel 23:24
segments: Asahel the brother of Joab [was] of the thirty; Elhanan the son of Dodo of Bethlehem;

entries.title: II Samuel 23:25
segments: Shammah the Harodite; Elika the Harodite;

entries.title: II Samuel 23:26
segments: Helez the Paltite; Ira the son of Ikkesh, the Tekoite;

entries.title: II Samuel 23:27
segments: Abiezer the Anathothite; Mebunnai the Hushathite;

entries.title: II Samuel 23:28
segments: Zalmon the Ahohite; Maharai the Netophathite;

entries.title: II Samuel 23:29
segments: Heleb the son of Baanah, a Netophathite; Ittai the son of Ribai out of Gibeah, of the sons of Benjamin;

entries.title: II Samuel 23:30
segments: Benaiah the Pirathonite; Hiddai of the brooks of Gaash;

entries.title: II Samuel 23:31
segments: Abialbon the Arbathite; Azmaveth the Barhumite;

entries.title: II Samuel 23:32
segments: Eliahba the Shaalbonite, of the sons of Jashen; Jonathan;

entries.title: II Samuel 23:33
segments: Shammah the Hararite; Ahiam the son of Sharer, the Hararite;

entries.title: II Samuel 23:34
segments: Eliphelet the son of Ahasbai, the son of the Maachathite; Eliam the son of Ahithophel, the Gilonite;

entries.title: II Samuel 23:35
segments: Hezrai the Carmelite; Paarai the Arbite;

entries.title: II Samuel 23:36
segments: Igal the son of Nathan of Zobah; Bani the Gadite;

entries.title: II Samuel 23:37
segments: Zelek the Ammonite; Naharai the Beerothite, armor-bearer to Joab the son of Zeruiah;

entries.title: II Samuel 23:38
segments: Ira, and Ithrite; Gareb, and Ithrite;

entries.title: II Samuel 23:39
segments: Uriah the Hittite-- thirty-seven in all.
